overview.zh: 进入印尼应采用“政策合规先行、伙伴验证、小规模示范、区域复制”的节奏。新能源设备企业宜先锁定工业园区、国有电力体系相关项目和本地经销服务网络，再逐步评估本地组装或合资安排。
overview.en: Market entry should follow a sequence of policy compliance, partner validation, small-scale demonstration, and regional replication. Equipment companies should first target industrial parks, projects linked to the state power ecosystem, and local distribution/service networks before assessing assembly or joint-venture options.

detail.zh: 梳理进口许可、本地含量、产品认证、并网和安全标准，形成产品线级别的合规清单。
detail.en: Map import licenses, local-content rules, product certification, grid-connection requirements, and safety standards into a product-line compliance checklist.

detail.zh: 优先验证 EPC、经销商、律所和政府事务顾问的项目履历、付款能力与合规记录。
detail.en: Prioritize verification of EPCs, distributors, law firms, and government-affairs advisors by project track record, payment capacity, and compliance history.

detail.zh: 选择工业园区、商业屋顶、储能微网或充电站等场景，建立可展示的成本、性能和运维数据。
detail.en: Select scenarios such as industrial parks, C&I rooftops, storage microgrids, or charging sites to build demonstrable cost, performance, and O&M data.

title.zh: 评估本地化和融资结构

detail.zh: 在订单稳定后评估组装、售后仓、本地融资和合资结构，避免过早重资产投入。
detail.en: After order stability improves, assess assembly, service warehouses, local financing, and joint-venture structures while avoiding premature heavy-asset commitments.

recommendedMode.zh: 推荐以本地渠道伙伴 + 项目型 EPC 联合开发起步，成熟后再评估轻资产组装或合资。
recommendedMode.en: Start with local channel partners plus project-based EPC co-development, then assess asset-light assembly or a joint venture after traction matures.
